scope: M3 hard region assignment from an admitted HSI block, implementation 19.15 and master 22.5
association: Maintainer implementation of Achanta et al. SLIC. The EPFL executable is not used.

license.applies_to: BSD-3-Clause umbrella for the SLIC Python module, Cython kernel and upstream tests. Other files in the library have their own exceptions.

adaptation: Call the installed official SLIC Python API and build CSR membership with region IDs canonicalized by first raster occurrence. Match preprocessing, compactness, smoothing, scale and connectivity across releases.
